source_caption_text:
Gucci Mane’s ability to make catchy songs was genuinely ridiculous 😂🔥

Gucci Mane really had a way of making songs stick. You could throw on one of his random mixtapes and somehow walk away with three or four songs stuck in your head for the rest of the day. “Lemonade” is probably the perfect example of that.

There’s something so simple about the song, but Gucci makes it work. The hook, the beat and his laid-back delivery all come together in a way that makes “Lemonade” impossible to forget.

That’s what made Gucci so good during that era. He didn’t need every song to be some huge record. He just had a ridiculous ability to make a line, hook or melody stick with you. 

#guccimane #hiphop #meme
